name: logo-a-cathead

Perfectly symmetrical and centered. Solid warm gold (#F2B418) shape on a flat off-white (#F7F5F0) background. No gradients, no shadows, no bevels, no 3D, no outlines, no text, no letters, no watermark. Extremely simple, friendly and confident. Huge empty margin around the mark. Brand identity sheet quality, in the visual language of the ZA Bank, Monzo and Revolut rebrands.

name: logo-e-lockup
prompt: Horizontal logo lockup on a flat off-white (#F7F5F0) background, centered, very generous margins. Left: a small gold (#F2B418) geometric lucky-cat head mark (circle head, two triangle ears, three straight whiskers each side). Right: the lowercase wordmark "luckycat" set in a bold geometric sans-serif in deep ink navy (#0E1B26), tightly tracked, with the small uppercase word "BANK" underneath in the same navy at one quarter the size with wide letter spacing. Spelling must be exactly "luckycat" and "BANK". Flat vector, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no extra text, no tagline, no watermark. Clean premium fintech brand sheet.

name: ui-01-dashboard-zh
prompt: Ultra-clean web app UI design for a virtual bank dashboard, desktop browser at 1440px wide, flat off-white (#F7F5F0) page background, pure white content cards with 24px radius and a single hairline (#E8E4DA) border, deep ink-navy (#0E1B26) text, warm gold (#F2B418) as the only accent, generous whitespace, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no neon, no drop shadows. Layout: a slim left sidebar with a small gold geometric cat logo and six simple line icons with short Simplified Chinese labels (总览 / 转账 / 银行卡 / 消费分析 / 安全中心 / 智能客服). Main area top: a large friendly greeting in bold Simplified Chinese, 你好，林小满, with the date underneath in gray. Below it one big white card: 活期账户, a large balance number 128,640.55, and two pill buttons 转入 and 转账. To the right a smaller white card: 本月支出 with a simple flat donut chart in gold and teal. Below the two cards, one wide white card titled 最近交易 listing four rows: each row has a small circular icon, a Simplified Chinese merchant name, a date, and a right-aligned amount. Bottom right corner: a small floating round gold chat button. All UI labels in correct Simplified Chinese characters, crisp and legible. Swiss rational grid, premium fintech product design, ZA Bank and Monzo app aesthetic, high fidelity, clean, breathable, uncluttered.

Premium fintech product design, ZA Bank and Monzo aesthetic, calm, breathable, high fidelity.
